command:
import argparse, importlib.util, json, os, signal, subprocess, sys, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import torch
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
source, previous, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("gpu_reservation", source)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
record = json.loads((previous / "reserved/record.json").read_text())
pid, expected = record["pid"], str(record["birth"])
def identity():
    try:
        return Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()[19]
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
assert identity() == expected
command = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0")
assert str(source).encode() in command
rows = subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi", "--query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"], text=True)
owners = [int(line.split(",")[1].strip()) for line in rows.splitlines() if line.split(",")[0].strip() == record["gpu"]]
assert owners == [pid], owners
module.write(output / "handoff", dict(at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), previous_record=str(previous / "reserved/record.json"), previous_pid=pid, previous_birth=expected, action="verified_single_project_reservation_renewal", GPU_workers_started=0))
assert identity() == expected
os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
end = time.monotonic() + 30
while identity() == expected and time.monotonic() < end:
    time.sleep(0.05)
assert identity() != expected, "old reservation did not exit"
args = argparse.Namespace(gpu=record["gpu"], output=output, ttl=3600, mib=73728, lease_path=Path(record["lease_path"]))
module.hold(args)
scope: single GPU0 preparation reservation renewal, no scientific worker
